text.name: searchables_help_shop_intro
text.text: A search box sits under BALANCE in the shop. Click it (or press the Search key: Ctrl+F, or the right stick on a controller) and type. The list updates as you type.

text.name: searchables_help_shop_list
text.text: Typing filters the list you are looking at. Example: open Amazone and type 4000.

text.name: searchables_help_shop_all
text.text: On the categories, brands, packs and DLC pages, type two or more letters to search the whole shop. Items with your words in their name come first.

text.name: searchables_help_shop_words
text.text: Name, brand, category, DLC, mod name and mod author. Every word must match: fendt 700, john deere tedder.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_intro
text.text: Type filters among your words. Each one works with >, <, >=, <=, a range like 6-9 or an exact number. k means thousand; m after a price means million.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_price
text.text: $<50k, price>100000, $100k-200k, $144,500. Type affordable to see only what your farm can pay for right now.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_power
text.text: hp>200, 200-300hp, 250hp, ps>200. needhp<150 finds tools your tractor can run.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_size
text.text: Working width: width>9, 6-9m. Capacity: l>30000, cap 20000-40000. Weight: t<10.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_speed
text.text: kph>50, mph>30, 50 km/h. Tools use their working speed.

text.name: searchables_help_filters_mix
text.text: fendt hp>300 $<400k. Results from the whole shop are sorted by the first filter you type.

text.name: searchables_help_construction
text.text: The search box sits next to the list of buildings. Typing filters every category and tab at once: silo, house, greenhouse. Price filters and affordable work here too. Buildings also match their description and products: peas finds every factory that uses or makes peas.

text.name: searchables_help_map_intro
text.text: Open the map and type in the box at the top. Every match gets an arrow that shrinks down onto it. Enter centers the map on the nearest one.

text.name: searchables_help_map_find
text.text: Your vehicles (also by license plate), bales, pallets, big bags, buildings, fields and properties. Examples: tractor, wool, round bale, silo, owned.

text.name: searchables_help_map_numbers
text.text: Type a number like 178 to find field or property 178. Type an NPC farmer's name to find the land they still own.

text.name: searchables_help_map_list
text.text: The nearest matches are listed under the search box with their distance. Click one to move the map there; click it again to make it your navigation target.

text.name: searchables_help_map_land
text.text: for sale marks every property you can buy, with price and size: for sale $<100k ha>5. contract marks fields with a contract you can take or are working on: contract harvest, contract huber.

text.name: searchables_help_map_filters
text.text: The shop's filters work here too: wool l>1000 finds big wool pallets, fendt hp>200 finds your own big Fendts.

text.name: searchables_help_fields_crops
text.text: Fields show their crop and what they need. Search for a crop or for ready, growing, withered, harvested, lime, fertilize, plow, roll, weeds or stones. Example: wheat ready.

text.name: searchables_help_fields_sell
text.text: Type sell and a product: sell wheat. Every selling point that buys it gets an arrow with its price per 1000 l, and the best price is marked.

text.name: searchables_help_controls_intro
text.text: The Search key jumps into the search box on the shop, construction and map screens: Ctrl+F on the keyboard, the right stick on a controller. Change it in the controls under Search. On Steam Deck and in Big Picture mode the on-screen keyboard opens.

text.name: searchables_help_controls_keys
text.text: Enter or clicking elsewhere keeps the search. Esc clears it. In the shop and the construction menu, going back or switching tabs clears it too.

text.name: searchables_help_controls_console
text.text: With the developer console: wmsFind, wmsTarget, wmsSummary, wmsList, wmsLeftovers, wmsShow, wmsGoto, wmsHide, wmsField, searchablesMove, searchablesDumpUi.

text.name: searchables_help_map_vehicles
text.text: Vehicles show fuel, damage and dirt when they need attention. Search fuel, damaged, dirty, helper, parked or leased, or use fuel<20, damage>50, dirt>50.

text.name: searchables_help_map_farm
text.text: Animal pens show how many animals they have and what is low: cows low. Production points show what they make, missing inputs and full outputs: flour, missing, full. stored wheat marks every storage holding wheat, with how much.

text.name: searchables_help_shop_more
text.text: Start a word with - to leave matches out: -mod hides mod items, -trailer hides trailers. mod shows only mod items. used finds second-hand items, and price filters use their sale price.

text.name: searchables_help_controls_quick
text.text: Press Ctrl+F while walking or driving to open the map with the cursor in the search box. While the box is empty, your last five searches are listed under it: click one to search it again.

text.name: searchables_help_controls_search
text.text: Settings > Controls has a search box above the list. Type an action, a section or a key: cruise control, lights, vehicle, ctrl, f5.
